items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: I was reading here in this article that and Mrs. Howard both mentioned the Nightingale... the Nightingale Club was sold to Frank Sebastian... INTERVIEWEE: That's right. ... INTERVIEWER: Were you working there when Frank Sebastian bought the club? INTERVIEWEE: Yes.

ctx.x: Let's see, Les Hite and Frank Sebastian, Lionel Hampton, don't give you all the names of the men playing in this --
No, probably not all of them.
